[[File:ImpForwardOutpost.jpg|thumb|250px|An armed Imperial Forward Outpost]]
'''Forward Outposts''' were a type of small base, which were established across a wide number of worlds. They were employed by both the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].

==Description==
[[File:RebelForwardOutpost.jpg|thumb|250px|A Rebel Forward Outpost]]
Forward Outposts could be armed with no more than two turrets. [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] operated Forward Outposts were often guarded by [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtroopers]], and staffed with an [[Imperial recruiter]]. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] also made use of Forward Outposts, with a [[Recruitment Agent]] staffing one of the offices.
